crossRefs.note: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.
We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women…
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will…
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
Gideon said to him, “Oh, my lord, if Yahweh is with us, why then has all this happened to us? Where are all his…
I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.
They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,
He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
translations.bsb: But do not be afraid of them. Be sure to remember what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt:
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
translations.asv: thou shalt not be afraid of them: thou shalt well remember what Jehovah thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
